Mumbai Muharram Capsule Case: Accused Motives Under Scrutiny

An accused in Mumbai allegedly distributed poisonous capsules during a Muharram procession. Investigations suggest the motive was personal distress and anger towards his community, rather than an immediate terrorist link. The accused reportedly harbored resentment stemming from personal issues and past events, leading to a plot against his own community.
